download_files hardening (2026-07-04): filters to an audio/manifest extension allowlist BEFORE download, caps at MAX_DOWNLOAD_FILES=20, independently validates every filename via safe_basename (not relying solely on the huggingface_hub library's own sanitization) -- accepted gap: no per-file/total byte-size cap yet

provenance populated on import as {source:'imported', author, consent_ack, created_at} -- correctly matches the REAL schema (not the pre-implementation plan's source='huggingface'/hub_id shape a sibling demo mockup mistakenly used)

does NOT call build_voice_asset (app/engines/bridge.py's build_voice_asset is a pre-existing NotImplementedError stub) -- import registers a new voice profile with raw samples; the user still uses the existing async Build job
